pages.heading: Mungus
pages.body: Mushroom Fields. Feed matching mushrooms to support its nearby mushroom growth. A Mungus killed while carrying five mushrooms explodes and can change the

pages.heading: Mungus (cont.)
pages.body: surrounding biome. A poisonous potato reverses a conversion. Naturally dropped Mungal Spores breed Mungi and transform rabbits into Bunfungi; keep experiments away from builds.
